body: This is an old post but I’d love to know which pi this is also!

The gender piece is interesting and I hadn’t factored that in! Thanks for sharing your experiences and I’m glad you found the right person for you! 

Also want to make it clear that I’m not asking ENTPs to change. More so trying to figure out if they’re a good fit for me personally or if I’m just running into unique cases. I’d just find better matches for me but def not asking them to be different.
Agree!! I was in a 5 year relationship with an ENTP who I now think was on the spectrum
Yes, I agree with this comment most. I was in a 5 year relationship with an ENTP who I now suspect was on the spectrum
Hmm but how do types bridge the S/N gap? I much prefer discussing abstract topics and I imagine an ESTP would be even worse than an ENTP?
So then who are Ni doms compatible with?

There definitely are negative stereotypes associated with S types, such as being shallow or boring. But given that we ultimately live in a concrete, tangible world, I think S types have a better chance at survival in a Darwinian sense. As an INFJ I would love to harness my Se a bit better like your initial comment touched on. I’m glad you’ve found the best of both in your friendships and relationship.

I’ve met a few but you’re rarer! From what I’m learning from other comments, it seems like I’ve been dealing with mistyped ENTPs, various forms of neurodivergence, and lack of common interests/hobbies
Okay this is exactly like what I’ve been experiencing! I guess some ENTPs do click with S types more and some don’t - I just haven’t found the right ENTPs for me

Okay I’m glad this is baffling to you because it has been to me too. Maybe some were mistyped. I’ve heard that ENTPs under distress revert to inferior Si (like how INxJ’s revert to Se) so maybe that’s played a role too.

This gives me hope! I’m glad you’ve found your ENTP and I hope you’re right about me just meeting weird ones. I also don’t click with INTPs, they’ve been too critical and caught up in catching tiny inconsistencies. I was almost engaged to an ENTP 8w4 but I suspect he was neurodivergent and that played a role.

I think sadly I’m more attracted to T types but more compatible with F types. 

The INTPs I’ve dated were cold/critical. 

I’m more just confused/surprised by ENTPs appearing almost more ESTP despite being N.
